A handwritten paper list is taped to the front of the wrapped console.
Two black game controllers sit in front of the console.
The controllers show PlayStation-style button symbols, analog sticks, D-pad, touchpad area, and PS button.
A watermark reading "GAMES AND GADGETS" appears across the image.
No model label or branding on the console itself is readable because it is covered by plastic.
